description: This file defines structures, functions, and macros for an abstract glyph cache in the FreeType project, including classes for glyph nodes, families, and cache management, with emphasis on extensibility and internal cache operations.

classes.name: FTC_Family
classes.description: Represents a family of glyphs grouped by attributes like face ID and size, implemented as an MRU list node with reference counting.

classes.name: FTC_GNode
classes.description: Represents a glyph node containing a glyph index and a pointer to its family, extending a generic cache node.

classes.name: FTC_GQuery
classes.description: Holds cache-specific query data, including glyph index and family reference.

classes.name: FTC_GCache
classes.description: Represents the glyph cache, managing families and cache operations.

classes.name: FTC_GCacheClass
classes.description: Defines the class structure for glyph cache implementations, including a reference to the family class.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_Init
methods.description: Initializes a glyph node with a glyph index and family.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_Compare
methods.description: Compares a glyph node with a query to determine if they match.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_UnselectFamily
methods.description: Clears the family association of a glyph node.

methods.name: FTC_GNode_Done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources associated with a glyph node.

methods.name: FTC_GCache_Done
methods.description: Finalizes and frees resources of a glyph cache.

methods.name: FTC_GCache_New
methods.description: Creates a new glyph cache instance.

methods.name: FTC_GCache_Lookup
methods.description: Looks up a glyph node in the cache based on hash, glyph index, and query.
